Which encoder is the most affordable from a French or German supplier?
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?product ?name ?amount WHERE {
  ?product <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Encoder> .
  ?product <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasSupplier> ?supplier .
  ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountry> ?country .
  FILTER(STR(?country) CONTAINS "France" || STR(?country) CONTAINS "Germany") .
  ?product <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price> ?price .
  ?price <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?amount .
  ?product <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?name .
}
ORDER BY ASC(?amount)
LIMIT 1

  ?emp <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept .

question: For each bill of materials, show the count of parts and the total material quantity, but display only those BOMs with more than 600 items, sorted in descending order.

query:
SELECT ?bom (COUNT(?part) AS ?partCount) (SUM(?quantity) AS ?totalQuantity)
WHERE {
  ?bom <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasBomPart> ?part .
  ?part <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/quantity> ?quantity .
}
GROUP BY ?bom

ORDER BY DESC(?partCount)
